_README: SEED LEXICON -- PLACEHOLDER DATA. Every entry has "reviewed": false because none of
these gloss choices have been confirmed by a fluent ISL signer, and no clips exist yet.
The UI renders unreviewed entries with a visible 'unverified' marker. Do not remove that
marker and do not flip 'reviewed' to true without a named signer sign-off recorded in
Week 2 task: replace this file with the 100-sign vocabulary locked with your advisor,
chosen for everyday utility. Week 5 task: record clips and fill in the 'clip' field.
This file is meant to be edited by non-programmers. Fields:
english    lowercase English surface forms that map to it
pos        noun | verb | adj | adv | pron | num | wh | neg | time | quant | other
clip       filename under VITE_CLIP_BASE_URL (omit if not recorded yet)
twoHanded  true if the sign uses both hands
reviewed   false until a fluent signer confirms gloss AND clip
Entries with notes "INCLUDE" were added so every sign in the INCLUDE dataset has a gloss; all remain unreviewed.

entries.notes: ISL commonly indexes a location in signing space rather than marking gender.
Community term for a non-deaf person, not the act of hearing.
Emitted automatically for past-tense verbs; ISL marks tense with time markers.
Emitted automatically for 'will'/'shall'.
